findings.body: This uses Discord's 2,000-character bot send limit as the inbound limit, but [Discord allows Nitro users to send 4,000 characters](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034632292-Sending-Messages). A 2,000-character Nitro message therefore waits 4 seconds although it is only halfway to its limit and should receive the ordinary 1.5-second window. Incoming content reaches admission through apps/core/src/channels/discord/index.ts:619. Keep the outbound limit separate and use the applicable inbound limit for this threshold.
findings.title: Use Discord's inbound limit for the near-limit threshold
